english.note: Use this colloquial verb when someone hurries or goes extremely fast, such as racing home or racing for the door.

exampleSentences.english: As soon as the bell rings, the students race out of the classroom.
exampleSentences.traditional: 落堂鐘一響，啲學生就飛出課室。
